faq.a: {site} is an online platform with in-depth self-tests on personality, relationships, work and wellbeing. You can take every test for free and order a detailed personal report if you want to know more.

faq.q: How much does a test cost?
faq.a: Taking a test is free. The detailed personal report costs {price}, paid once. There is no subscription and you will never be charged again automatically.

faq.q: How do I receive my report?
faq.a: After payment your report is sent to the email address you entered, usually within a minute. Can't find it? Check your spam or promotions folder.
Yes, as often as you like. Retaking a test after a few weeks is a good way to see what has changed. Each report is a separate one-time purchase.

No. Our tests are meant for self-reflection. Screeners such as the ADHD or depression test can indicate whether it makes sense to talk to a professional, but they never replace an assessment by a qualified professional.

Our tests are based on established psychological models such as the Big Five, RIASEC and attachment theory. The depression and trauma tests also include the public-domain PHQ-9 and PCL-5 questionnaires, scored with their official cut-offs.

Every questionnaire has a margin of error, and your mood on the day can play a role. Answer honestly and without overthinking, and see your result as a starting point for reflection rather than a final verdict.
Yes. You don't need an account. Your answers are only used to calculate your result and create your report, and we never sell your data.

privacyBody: We only collect the data needed to provide our service: your test answers and, if you buy a report, your email address.

Your answers are processed to calculate your result. When you buy a report, your answers and email address are passed to our payment provider Stripe and our email provider in order to process the payment and deliver the report.
We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising. You can ask us at any time to delete your data by contacting {email}.
Payments are handled by Stripe. We never see or store your card details.
termsBody: All tests on {site} are intended for self-reflection and entertainment. They are not a medical, psychological or professional diagnosis.
Taking a test is free. A personal report costs {price} per test as a one-time payment. The report is delivered digitally by email.

Because the report is digital content delivered immediately after payment, you agree that the right of withdrawal expires once the report has been sent. If you did not receive your report, contact {email} and we will resend it or refund you.
We do our best to keep the content accurate, but we cannot guarantee that the results are complete or correct for every person.
cookiesBody: {site} does not use advertising or tracking cookies.
We only store strictly necessary data in your browser: your chosen language and your progress in a test, so you can continue where you left off. This data stays on your device.
When you pay, our payment provider Stripe may place cookies needed to process the payment securely and prevent fraud.
refundBody: A report costs {price} per test as a one-time payment. There is no subscription and no automatic renewal.
Did you not receive your report, or did something go wrong? Contact {email} within 14 days, mentioning the email address you used, and we will resend your report or refund your payment.
Because the report is digital content that is delivered immediately, the statutory right of withdrawal expires once it has been sent. We will still always help you if something is not right.
Refunds are made to the original payment method within 5–10 business days.

about.title: About {site}
about.intro: We believe everyone deserves a clear, honest look at who they are — without jargon, without subscriptions and without a four-letter label that explains nothing.
about.mission: Psychology has developed powerful ways to describe personality, relationships and wellbeing, but most of that knowledge is locked away in textbooks or expensive assessments. {site} makes it accessible: in-depth tests anyone can take for free, in their own language, with a personal report that explains your results in plain words and gives you practical next steps.

how.title: Established models
how.text: Every test is based on well-researched frameworks such as the Big Five, RIASEC and attachment theory. Where public-domain clinical questionnaires exist, such as the PHQ-9 and PCL-5, we include them and use their official scoring.

how.title: 100 questions, 5 minutes
how.text: Each test uses 100 short statements spread over every dimension it measures. That gives a far more reliable picture than a quick ten-question quiz, while still taking only about five minutes.

how.title: Written to be read
how.text: Our reports explain what each score means, where it comes from and what you can do with it. No jargon and no vague horoscope language — just clear, practical insight.

values.title: No account, no subscription
values.text: You pay {price} once for a report you want. Nothing renews, nothing is charged later.

values.title: Privacy first
values.text: Your answers are only used to calculate your result. We don't sell data and don't show ads.

values.title: Available in {languages} languages
values.text: Every test and every report is available in all major European languages.

values.title: Honest about limits
values.text: Our tests support self-reflection. Screeners can tell you whether it makes sense to talk to a professional, but they never replace a diagnosis.
